title: CLR/74/2024 of VIRENDRA SINGH NEGI Vs MEERU PHUL

paras.text:

HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTI CE ALOK KUMAR VERMA
0 2 n d SEPTEMBER, 2 0 2 4
CI VI L REVI SI ON NO.7 4 OF 2 0 2 4
Virendra Singh Negi ...Revisionist
 Versus
Sm t. Meeru Phul ...Respondent
Counsel for the Revisionist : Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate.

Hon 'b le Alok Ku m ar Ver m a,J.
 The proposed Revision has been filed against
the order dated 22.07.2024, passed by learned Judge,
Sm all Cause Court/ District Judge, Pauri in SCC Suit
No.05 of 2023, "Sm t. Meeru Phul vs. Virendra Singh
Negi", by which, the learned Judge has dismissed the
Application, filed by the proposed revisionist -
defendant under Order VI I Rule 11 of the Code of Civil
Procedure, 1908.
2 . Heard Mr. Kurban Ali, learned counsel for the
proposed revisionist.
3 . Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate subm its that the
revisionist - defendant had taken two grounds in his
Application. The first ground was that the Judge, Sm all
Cause Court/ District Judge, Pauri has no inherent
jurisdiction to hear the said suit and the plaint does not
 1

2024:UHC:6279
disclose any cause of action.
4 . Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate has conceded that
the judgment of the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature at
Allahabad in Amit Gupta vs. Gulab Chandra Kanodia,
(2023)(2) ARC 390 is against the revisionist. Therefore,
the revisionist does not want to press the first ground.
5 . From the perusal of the copy of the plaint it
becom es clear that the plaintiff has disclosed the cause
of action in paragraph no.14 of the plaint.
6 . Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate has failed to show
that the trial court has exercised a jurisdiction not
vested in it by law, or has failed to exercise a
jurisdiction so vested, or has acted in exercise of its
jurisdiction illegally or with m aterial irregularity.
7 . Therefore, there is no good ground to
entertain the proposed Revision. The Revision is liable
to be dismissed; the same is dismissed at the
admission stage.
_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
